gaps.title: Background sync ignores Moodle courses and departments
gaps.jtbd: When my Moodle course enrollment changes, I want my archive access to be automatically updated, so that I cannot access closed strains for courses I am no longer enrolled in.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a scheduled Moodle sync job, When it fetches user profiles, Then it must synchronize the user's courses and department in addition to their role.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'Автоматическое разграничение прав доступа... на основе кафедр и курсов Moodle' implies the system state must accurately reflect Moodle enrollments, which the current background sync omits

gaps.title: Missing SSO user deactivation sync
gaps.jtbd: When an employee is deactivated in the external LMS, I want their local archive account to be automatically suspended, so that they cannot bypass revocation using the autonomous fallback login.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user with a local fallback password, When their Moodle account is suspended or deleted, Then the background sync detects the suspension and disables the local user account.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation for SSO systems with local credential fallback
